marks.gloss_en: דלמא שבקי ליה ואזלי -- lest they [the escorting holy ones] leave him and go
one entering the privy says: 'be honoured, honoured holy ones, servants of the Most High; give honour to the God of Israel; leave me until I enter and do my will and come [back] to you'
הלכך נמרינהו לתרוייהו -- Shmuel's 'who heals all flesh' is one of the two
הלכך נמרינהו לתרוייהו -- Rav Sheshet's 'who does wonders' is the other
אמר שמואל: קא שוינהו אבא לכולי עלמא קצירי -- Abba [Rav] has made everyone ill! (so he proposes 'who heals all flesh' instead)
with what does he close? Rav: 'who heals the sick'
one going to sleep on his bed says from 'Hear, O Israel' until 'and it shall be, if you listen'
and when he wakes he says: 'My God, the soul You placed in me is pure...', ending 'Blessed are You, Lord, who restores souls to dead bodies'
on hearing the rooster, let him say: 'Blessed... who gave the rooster understanding to distinguish between day and night'
on wrapping himself in tzitzit: 'Blessed... who sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us to wrap ourselves in tzitzit'
והתנן: על בשורות טובות אומר הטוב והמטיב, על בשורות רעות אומר ברוך דיין האמת -- the mishnah gives bad tidings a different blessing
the mishnah: a person is obligated to bless over the bad just as he blesses over the good
כי הא דרבי עקיבא -- refused lodging and stripped of lamp, rooster and donkey, he said 'all is for the good', and that night the town was taken captive

R' Akiva was on the road, came to a town, asked for lodging and was not given it; he slept in the field with a rooster, a donkey and a lamp; a wind put out the lamp, a cat ate the rooster, a lion ate the donkey; that night an army came and took the town captive
Rav Acha in R' Levi's name: what is the verse? 'I will sing of kindness and justice; to You, Lord, I will sing praise' (Ps 101:1)
R' Shmuel bar Nachmani: from here -- 'in the Lord I will praise the word, in God I will praise the word' (Ps 56:11)
R' Tanchum: from here -- 'I will lift the cup of salvation and call on the name of the Lord' (Ps 116:13), 'I found trouble and sorrow, and I call on the name of the Lord' (Ps 116:3-4)
the Rabbis: from here -- 'the Lord gave and the Lord took; blessed be the name of the Lord' (Job 1:21)
a person should always be accustomed to say: all that the Merciful One does, He does for the good
